acceptance.assertion: The systemd importer invokes import-outbox in a compact summary mode that emits exactly one bounded JSON line per run and excludes bundle inventories and per-source result lists.
The summary preserves aggregate error count and at most three length-bounded error samples, remains below 4096 bytes in the tested worst case and retains nonzero exit status when errors exist.
The import-outbox CLI default remains the existing full output mode so callers that do not opt into summary output keep their current result schema and detail.
The user unit adds an independent LogRateLimitIntervalSec and LogRateLimitBurst guard without changing the two-minute timer or Chronik read/write sandbox.
The Chronik role contract, focused tests, complete test suite, API smoke, GitHub CI and exact-head review pass.

A versioned exact-head deployment runs at least one scheduled import while journald records no new global user@1000.service suppression attributable to the importer, and rollback remains possible without ledger mutation.

approval.note: The user explicitly authorized implementing all sensible remediations and continued execution on 2026-07-31. Registry publication, merge and runtime rollout remain separately evidence-bound.

goal: Stoppe den durch vollständige Batch-JSON-Ausgabe verursachten globalen User-Journalverlust, ohne Chronik-Import-, Ledger-, Receipt- oder CLI-Kompatibilitätssemantik zu schwächen.

does_not_establish: permission to rewrite ledger or receipt history
general safety of arbitrary user-service output
metadata.finding: chronik-outbox-import.service produced 9,998 of 10,000 stored user-journal messages in the first 30 seconds before journald suppression, followed by roughly 42,000 suppressed messages per two-minute run.

source.locator: heim-pc journal boot 2026-07-31 05:54:59..05:55:29 CEST; chronik-outbox-import.service PID 1673710

rollback.procedure: Atomically restore the previous immutable Chronik release and previous user unit, reload the user manager, rerun the importer, and preserve all ledger, receipt, outbox and diagnostic evidence unchanged.
rollback.trigger: The summary hides importer failure, exceeds its bound, changes full-mode output, breaks import semantics, or live suppression continues after deployment.
